semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company specializes in CNC machining parts and custom components, which are not directly semiconductor-specific.
summary: FMSX Smart Technology (Dongguan) Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer focused on high-mixed low-volume production of CNC machining parts and custom components. Established in 2017, the company utilizes advanced machining technologies and ERP systems to ensure quality and efficiency in its manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Fully automated manufacturing with ERP and barcode systems

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, with a manufacturing facility of 6,600 ㎡.
